name: logicforge-monorepo
description: Веб-орієнтована інформаційна система моделювання та симуляції цифрових логічних схем (LogicForge Studio)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SHARED,SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @logicforge/shared-types" "npm run dev -w @logicforge/server" "npm run dev -w @logicforge/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @logicforge/shared-types && npm run build -w @logicforge/server && npm run build -w @logicforge/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @logicforge/shared-types && npm run test -w @logicforge/shared-types && npm run test -w @logicforge/server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @logicforge/shared-types && npm run test:coverage -w @logicforge/shared-types
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @logicforge/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @logicforge/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @logicforge/server && npm run typecheck -w @logicforge/client
scripts.check: npm run spellcheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
